'/mnt/cold-a/Backup/db-dumps/pg/papercusp-transcript' has not advanced in 19 hours (size 179B). The DB dump is supposed to run ~hourly.\n\nTHIS IS THE SIGNAL THAT WAS MISSING. On 2026-07-12 the backup had been failing 100% for ~30 DAYS (newest good dump 2026-06-12) and nothing detected it, because a plausible-looking 1.4GB .gz sat on disk the whole time. 'The backup file exists' is not 'the backup works' — only its FRESHNESS discriminates.\n\nLIKELY CAUSES (check in this order):\n 1. db-backup.sh's timer stopped firing: systemctl --user status papercusp-db-backup.timer papercusp-db-backup.service ; journalctl --user -u papercusp-db-backup.service -n 50. Read /mnt/cold-a/Backup/db-dumps/STATUS.json (ok / failed[] / lastSuccessEpoch) and /mnt/cold-a/Backup/db-dumps/db-backup.log.\n 2. A specific DB's dump is failing validation: db-backup.sh only renames a dump into place after pg_restore -l passes, so a per-DB 'FAIL' in db-backup.log means the archive was unreadable or the dump errored — read the actual pg_dump error there. DO NOT blindly raise PC_BACKUP_TIMEOUT_SEC without reading it.\n 3. An orphaned pg_dump is holding locks (the EI-10730 knock-on): check for a pg_dump backend older than its timeout (SELECT pid, application_name, backend_start FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE application_name LIKE 'pg_dump%'). db-backup.sh tags its own dumps PGAPPNAME=pcbackup and reaps foreign ones; a lingering 'pg_dump%' backend is a legacy/manual dump.\n 4. Disk full on the backup volume: df -h /mnt/cold-a/Backup/db-dumps\n\nAn orphaned/stuck dump is not just a dead backup — it holds AccessShareLock on ~593 tables, which starves every migration's ACCESS EXCLUSIVE and can wedge the whole release pipeline (EI-10730).","state":"open","assignee":"su-e8682264-ac17-4824-a076-c59d4778ef0c","takenAt":"2026-11-08T14:15:05.960Z","lastProgressAt":"2026-11-09T10:09:28.911Z","assignedBy":null,"createdBy":"su-loopback","severity":"critical","goalId":null,"tags":null,"sourcePlanSlug":null,"sourcePlanItemIds":null,"redundancy":null,"expectedCostCents":null,"parent":null,"payload":{"_ei":{"scope":"harness:papercusp","source":"engineer","severity":"critical","created_by":"su-loopback","signal_origin":"organic"},"tags":["backup","data-safety","host-health"],"dedupCoverage":{"lexical":"ok","degraded":false,"semantic":"ok"},"dedupCandidates":[{"id":"WI-10007742","method":"semantic-hard","similarity":0.9807761007778679},{"id":"WI-10000840","method":"semantic-hard","similarity":0.9806792736053467},{"id":"WI-6554700010008518","method":"semantic-hard","similarity":0.9806693488558937},{"id":"WI-10000693","method":"semantic-hard","similarity":0.9806026827929822},{"id":"WI-6554700010012798","method":"semantic-hard","similarity":0.9805715072495661},{"id":"WI-6554700010011203","method":"semantic-hard","similarity":0.980539442268645}],"admissionIdentity":{"titleKey":"title:19h
